posts.text: INJ burns cleared through the burn auction and supply came down. INJ burns are the headline.
I keep coming back to INJ burns. Fee pool in, supply out, auction done. INJ burns on repeat.
Yes. INJ burns and the burn auction are the tokenomics on my desk. Supply is the outcome of INJ burns.
Fees reached the pool and paid for INJ burns. The auction retired supply after INJ burns.
INJ burns again. Burn auction, fee pool, and supply. Nothing else in tokenomics beats INJ burns.
Supply printed after the INJ burns. I look at the auction afterward. INJ burns come first.
Sending fees into the pool so INJ burns can run is my favorite tokenomics. INJ burns, then the auction.
Fresh INJ burns. The auction cleared and supply responded to INJ burns.
